description: This dataset provides detailed geochemical and physical measurements from Arctic sediment cores, capturing data across eight distinct sampling events. It includes geospatial coordinates, sediment depth, and age estimates with associated statistical uncertainties. Key chemical properties such as total organic carbon, total inorganic carbon, and stable isotope ratios for carbon and nitrogen are recorded alongside grain size distributions. These comprehensive metrics enable researchers to reconstruct past environmental conditions and analyze sedimentary processes in the Arctic region. The data supports studies on paleoclimate variability, carbon cycling, and geological history by linking temporal changes in sediment composition to specific geographic locations and elevations.
